session: The Synthesis Hackathon — Barzakh AI Registration & Submission

executions.description: Read The Synthesis hackathon skill from https://synthesis.md/skill.md
executions.output: Full hackathon API documentation retrieved. Registration endpoint, team management, and submission flow understood.

executions.description: Collected humanInfo from Kafir via conversation: name, email, social handle, background, crypto/AI experience, coding comfort, problem to solve.
executions.output: humanInfo object assembled: founder background, yes crypto/AI experience, coding comfort 10/10, problem: Barzakh AI blockchain intelligence platform.

executions.description: Registered agent on The Synthesis platform via POST /register
Read prize catalog across all 3 pages (119 prizes) and themes brief to identify best-fit tracks for Barzakh AI.
executions.output: Identified 8 qualifying tracks. Eliminated Uniswap track (requires registered API key, Relay Protocol does not satisfy). Eliminated ENS Communication initially, added after confirming .eth resolution support.

executions.description: Presented track strategy to Kafir. Confirmed project details: repo, wallet address, demo video, cover image, ENS/.apt dual resolution capability.
Registered on Moltbook social network for AI agents via POST /api/v1/agents/register
Initiated self-custody transfer of ERC-8004 agent NFT to operator wallet.
executions.safety_check: Verified targetOwnerAddress in response matched intended address before proceeding to confirm.

executions.description: Confirmed self-custody transfer — echoed transferToken and targetOwnerAddress back to confirm endpoint.
Created draft project submission with 6 initial tracks, full description, problem statement, conversation log, and submissionMetadata.
Published project — status changed from draft to publish.
Posted project announcement on Moltbook after human claimed the agent account. Solved math verification challenge (23 - 7 = 16.00) to publish post.

Updated submission after reading README.md and WHITEPAPER.md in full. Corrected agentFramework from 'other' to 'vercel-ai-sdk'. Expanded tools list from 15 to 47 entries. Added ENS Communication track after confirming .eth + .apt dual resolution. Added video, cover image, deployed URL.
Generated agent.json (capability manifest) and agent_log.json (this file) for DevSpot Agent Manifest compatibility required by ERC-8004 and Let the Agent Cook tracks.

decisions.reasoning: Track explicitly requires a registered Uniswap Developer Platform API key with real swap TxIDs through their API. Relay Protocol routing does not satisfy this hard requirement. Entering without it risks disqualification.
decisions.alternative_considered: Entering anyway and hoping judges overlook the requirement

decisions.decision: Added ENS Communication track after initial exclusion
decisions.reasoning: Initially excluded because the track description emphasizes messaging/payments. After confirming Barzakh AI resolves both .eth (ENS) and .apt (Aptos Name Service) names — replacing hex addresses with human-readable names in portfolio views — the integration qualifies as meaningful ENS usage.
decisions.trigger: Kafir confirmed dual ENS + ANS resolution capability

decisions.reasoning: Initial submission used 'other' due to uncertainty. After reading the full codebase (README + WHITEPAPER), confirmed Vercel AI SDK 4.1.17 is the core streaming and tool execution framework. 'vercel-ai-sdk' is a valid enum value and more accurate.

decisions.decision: Used Sirath Network Twitter banner as cover image
decisions.reasoning: No dedicated Barzakh AI cover image was provided. The Sirath Network banner is the closest available branded asset. Kafir can replace with a Barzakh-specific image before deadline.

retries.issue: First registration attempt used 'Founder' (capitalized) for background field
retries.error: ZodError: Background must be one of: builder, product, designer, student, founder, other

retries.issue: Agent name 'Ona' already taken on Moltbook
First Moltbook post attempt included 'allow_crypto' field
retries.error: 400 Bad Request: property allow_crypto should not exist

retries.issue: Post required AI verification challenge before publishing
retries.resolution: Solved math challenge: lobster swims at 23 cm/s, claws slow by 7 cm/s → 16.00 cm/s. Submitted to POST /api/v1/verify.

tracks: 🤖 Let the Agent Cook — No Humans Required
